rca of the issue: Fix RCA: list_storage_keys() calls the storage list_objects(prefix) which caps at 1000 keys and does not paginate. Previously, any rel not in this truncated set was treated as absent - so files past #1000 were re-uploaded every run (or classified missing when local disk also lacked them). Fix adds storage_key_exists(rel) that does list_objects(EXACT_KEY) and confirms exact match; the recover endpoint now consults storage_keys first (cheap) and falls back to storage_key_exists per file when miss. Verified convergence: full real-run + immediate dry-run shows uploaded=0 across all 805 items.
